hypothesis: Zero unused envelope periods accumulate counter work in Fuse; repeated gates/restarts and early ENV enables cause control discontinuities.
limitations: Counter-work prediction and16-second DAC-step probes do not establish physical audibility or sound-card underruns. Full native/Fuse delivery checks are separate.

dac_steps.limitations: Same-phase DAC changes exclude ordinary oscillator edges. Serial events use measured219/241-T write paths, rounded to44.1kHz samples. Not perceptual click audibility or full Z80/Fuse qualification.

fuse_counter.scope: Published Fuse AY-loop counter model;32-T step approximation; not measured host stalls.
